name: docs-ssh-daily-update
description: Daily docs refresh: sync repo -> fetch docs (persistent cache) -> build image on router daemon -> push latest+date tag to GHCR (non-fatal) -> recreate docs-ssh -> smoke against live. Replaces the GitHub update-docs cron. Releases keep building on GitHub.

cmd: set -e; cd /work/repo; if [ ! -d .git ]; then git init -q .; git remote add origin https://github.com/erfianugrah/docs-ssh.git; fi; git fetch --tags --prune origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'; git reset --hard origin/main; git log --oneline -1
cd /work/repo && DOCS_OUT_DIR=/work/repo/docs DOCS_WORK_DIR=/tmp/docs-work DOCS_MAX_AGE=0 pnpm fetch-docs

set -e; cd /work/repo; DATE=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); VER=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo v0.0.0)-daily.$DATE; echo "building VERSION=$VER"; docker build --build-arg DOCS_PREBUILT=true --build-arg VERSION=$VER --build-arg SSH_HOST=docs.erfi.io --build-arg SSH_PORT=2222 -t ghcr.io/erfianugrah/docs-ssh:latest -t ghcr.io/erfianugrah/docs-ssh:$DATE .

rc=0; docker push ghcr.io/erfianugrah/docs-ssh:latest || rc=1; DATE=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); docker push ghcr.io/erfianugrah/docs-ssh:$DATE || rc=1; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' ghcr.io/erfianugrah/docs-ssh | grep -E ':[0-9]{8}$' | sort -r | tail -n +8 | xargs -r docker rmi >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit $rc
